title: Seance — privacy demo
summary: Compare what strangers, recipients and auditors can learn from private Esmeralda payments. The creator’s v2 searches the latest 40 indexer transactions locally before asking for a user-entered ID; an explicit Ask for it anyway action can disclose that ID. November 5 review read both live versions, the original announcements and creator videos. The initial example remains a labeled saved October 20 copy. A read-only Summon inspection during this review returned a current Commit receipt; request counters are the page’s own report. The creator’s November 4 update identifies a republished SeanceAuditorToken template after the November 2 reset; its indexer ABI page was reachable. Old token state and payments were removed, while the saved ledger remains available. Receipts alone cannot reverify missing encrypted transaction bodies. Optional Sapient payments go to a demonstration recipient whose view key is public. Timing, fees and spend links remain visible; the quantum discussion is a simulation using published demo keys. The unchanged October 31 recording covers the transaction picker and request disclosure, with no wallet or payment. Historical creator wallet footage is not a new transaction test. v1 remains available at its earlier URL; this project is distinct from DevXTools’ sealed polls.
cardSummary: Compare what strangers, recipients and auditors can read from private testnet payments, including the metadata that remains public.
